Excellent service! My Cocker Spaniel was very hyperactive, jumping on people, biting during playtime, and had difficulty obeying.

Besides his technical competence, Jhon is very polite, patient, dedicated, and shows enormous affection for animals. You can see the care and respect he has for each dog.

Another unexpected point was how much better I learned to manage my own emotions in relation to my dog. The training ended up helping both of us.

I am very grateful for the service provided and recommend them wholeheartedly!
